newsitem.title: USA: Gillette says Henry Kravis to join board.
newsitem.headline: Gillette says Henry Kravis to join board.

text.p: The Gillette Co board of directors said on Thursday that it had elected Henry R. Kravis to its board, effective with the completion of the merger of Duracell International Inc with Gillette.
Kravis is a founding general partner of Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co LP and a director of Duracell, Borden Inc, Safeway Inc and Owens-Illinois Inc, among others.
After the merger, which is expected to occur by year-end, shares owned by affiliates of KKR Associates will represent about 6.8 percent of total Gillette outstanding shares.
The company said it expected Kravis to be nominated to be voted upon by Gillette stockholders at its annual meeting on April 17 to serve a three-year term that expires in April of the year 2000.
